howItWorks.title: How LordTraining works
howItWorks.subtitle: From initial diagnosis to professional export — a complete flow in 6 phases
howItWorks.step1_desc: Define the sport, competitive category, dominant physical capabilities and period objectives. The system adapts all parameters to your context.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Choose from 5 methodological models (Traditional, ATR, Blocks, Undulating, Concurrent). Configure the macrocycle with dates, competitions and phases.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Divide your plan into mesocycles with specific objectives and weekly microcycles. Assign volume, intensity and density loads per phase.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Create entities, teams and athlete profiles. Assign individual or collective plans. Control the physical profile and history of each athlete.
howItWorks.step5_desc: Capture each session with volume, intensity, RPE, exercises and methods. Compare planned vs. executed in real time.
howItWorks.step6_desc: Visualize ACWR, accumulated load, monotony and adherence. Generate professional reports in PDF/Excel. AI suggests smart adjustments.

models.title: 5 Methodological Models
models.subtitle: The system doesn't impose a model — you choose the right one
models.traditional_desc: Linear progression from volume to intensity. For developing athletes.
models.atr_desc: Sequential blocks: Accumulation, Transformation and Realization.
models.blocks_desc: Concentrated loads with high specificity. For elite athletes.
models.undulating_desc: Non-linear variation of load and intensity within the week.
models.concurrent_desc: Simultaneous development of multiple physical capacities.

social.title: Results you can expect
social.subtitle: Illustrative experiences from those who already train with method
social.disclaimer: * The testimonials presented are illustrative and represent typical use cases of the platform. Individual results may vary.
social.t1_text: I went from planning in Excel to having everything integrated in one place. Loads, athletes, reports. Now I spend that time coaching better, not managing spreadsheets.
social.t2_text: Visual periodization changed my coaching staff's life. Everyone sees the same plan, in real time. No more misunderstandings between sessions.
social.t3_text: With ACWR and monotony indicators we notably reduced injuries in the first season. Now we make decisions with data, not intuition.
social.t4_text: I manage 4 teams from a single panel. Before I needed three different tools and still lost information. Now everything is in LordTraining.
social.t5_text: My youth athletes now have real development tracking. Parents see progress, I control the load. I professionalized my school without hiring more staff.
social.t6_text: We standardized the planning methodology for 18 affiliated clubs. For the first time we have comparable data across regions and can make real decisions.
social.t7_text: I'm not a tech expert but I understood LordTraining in one afternoon. Now I generate my athletes' plans in minutes and have all history accessible from my phone.
social.t8_text: Long-term development tracking helped us identify talents that went unnoticed before. Now we develop better because we measure better.
social.t9_text: Automatic reports save me hours every week. Before, preparing the monthly board report took me a full day. Now I export it in two clicks.
social.t10_text: We implemented LordTraining as the official protocol for national call-ups. The selection team now arrives with real load data from each athlete. It's a before and after.
social.t10_role: Head of High Performance - National Triathlon Federation
